moldft_final.deck:
# S4c3 fixture deck: H2, one rung, one frequency.
molecule H2
  units atomic
  eprec 1e-6
  no_orient true
  H 0 0 -0.7
  H 0 0 0.7
end

moldft gs
  molecule H2
  xc hf
  L 20
  localize canon
  protocol [1e-4]
  dconv 1e-3
  maxiter 30
  requested_properties [energy, dipole]
end

molresponse optical
  reference gs
  protocol [1e-4]
  dconv 1e-2
  maxiter 30
  requested_properties [polarizability]
  polarizability.frequencies [0.0]
  polarizability.frequency_units au
  polarizability.components [zz]
end
